title: The Crystal Disappears
description: Plot: Inciting incident - the Rainbow Crystal vanishes, academy's protection fails | Emotion: Fear, urgency, and determination to help despite being told not to | Setting: The Crystal Chamber and Academy Main Hall at Early morning, next day | Characters: Headmistress Aurora, Princess Luna, Princess Ruby, Princess Sage, All Unicorn Partners, Academy Students and Staff (ensemble)
lyrics:
Something's wrong, I can feel it
In the air, in the light
Something's wrong, and I fear
We're not safe here tonight

The protections that have kept us
All these years strong and true
Are failing, and I don't know
What we're going to do

Something's wrong, something's wrong
We can feel it in our bones
Something's wrong, something's wrong
We're not safe here on our own

The magic that protected us
Is fading with the dawn
Something's wrong, something's wrong
And our safety's nearly gone

LUNA:
Something's wrong, but we're here

RUBY:
And we're stronger than we know

SAGE:
Something's wrong, but together

ALL THREE:
We can face what lies below

We're not helpless, we're not children
We have minds and hearts and will
If there's danger in the shadows
We won't just be standing still

STARDUST:
In the starlight, I can see it

BLAZE:
In the fire, I can feel

WHISPER:
In the memories, I know

ALL UNICORNS:
This threat is very real

But we're bonded to our partners
And our magic's strong and bright
We'll stand guard through the darkness
We'll protect them through the night

ALL:
Something's wrong, something's wrong
But we're not alone in this
Something's wrong, something's wrong
But we won't just reminisce

AURORA:
I will keep you safe, I promise

STUDENTS:
We will help you if we can

ALL:
Something's wrong, but together
We will make our final stand

Something's wrong, something's wrong
But our courage will be strong
Something's wrong, something's wrong
But we'll right what has gone wrong

character_notes:
The Crystal Chamber is the sacred heart of Rainbow Academy - a circular room with a domed ceiling that shows the sky above. In the center, a crystal pedestal rises from the floor, normally holding the Rainbow Crystal that protects the academy and surrounding kingdom.

The chamber is designed with beautiful stained glass windows showing the academy's history, and the walls are lined with smaller crystals that normally pulse with harmonious light. Everything about the space should feel sacred, peaceful, and magically protected.

But now the central pedestal is empty, and the smaller crystals flicker weakly. Shadows seem to creep in from the corners, and the magical warmth that usually fills the space has been replaced by an unsettling chill.
